title: Introduction to gtfstools
text: GTFS feeds exist two main different forms: GTFS static GTFS realtime. package allows manipulate GTFS static feeds, common variation. feeds collection many csv-like files (.txt extension) contained single .zip file. GTFS .zip file composed least five required files, may also contain conditionally required optional files: Required: agency.txt, stops.txt, routes.txt, trips.txt, stop_times.txt Conditionally required: calendar.txt, calendar_dates.txt, feed_info.txt Optional: fare_attributes.txt, fare_rules.txt, shapes.txt, frequencies.txt, transfers.txt, pathways.txt, levels.txt, translations.txt, attributions.txt Please check official GTFS reference details specification.

title: Write GTFS files — write_gtfs
text: gtfs GTFS object, created read_gtfs(). path path .zip file feed written . files character vector containing name elements written feed. NULL (default), elements inside GTFS object written. standard_only Whether write standard files fields (defaults FALSE, drop extra files fields). as_dir Whether write feed directory, instead .zip file (defaults FALSE, means field written zip file). overwrite Whether overwrite existing .zip file (defaults TRUE). quiet Whether hide log messages progress bars (defaults TRUE). compression_level number 1 9 indicating much .zip file compressed. code: data_path <- system.file("extdata/spo_gtfs.zip", package = "gtfstools") gtfs <- read_gtfs(data_path)  tmp_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "tmpdir") dir.create(tmp_dir) list.files(tmp_dir) #' #> character(0) tmp_file <- tempfile(pattern = "gtfs", tmpdir = tmp_dir, fileext = ".zip") write_gtfs(gtfs, tmp_file) list.files(tmp_dir) #> [1] "gtfs1ad664eb9d0.zip"  gtfs_all_files <- read_gtfs(tmp_file) names(gtfs_all_files) #> [1] "agency"      "calendar"    "frequencies" "routes"      "shapes"      #> [6] "stop_times"  "stops"       "trips"        write_gtfs(gtfs, tmp_file, files = "stop_times") gtfs_stop_times <- read_gtfs(tmp_file) names(gtfs_stop_times) #> [1] "stop_times"

title: gtfstools (development version)
text: New function filter_by_date(), filters feed services run given dates. New function get_stops(), returns stops visited given trips /routes. New function convert_stops_to_shapes(), creates shapes link consecutive stops trips along straight lines, trips linked usable shape (given trips), assigns trips. New function get_dates(), returns dates feed service, Dates "YYYYMMDD" strings. New function get_active_services(), returns services active given dates. New function get_start_and_end_times(), returns earliest departure time latest arrival time stop_times, optionally restricted given trips dates. New functions get_stop_timetable() get_route_timetable(), return timetables given stops routes given dates: stop times trips run date, trip information. New function get_calendar_overlap(), returns number trips GTFS feed runs service days (counting departures listed frequencies) whether feeds service day, helping pick date several feeds can analysed together (e.g. routing accessibility analyses). resolution = "periods", returns periods feeds service, plot = TRUE plots either result (requires ggplot2). Feeds may given paths list GTFS objects. See new “Checking calendar overlap GTFS feeds” vignette (#85). Thanks @higgicd suggestion original check_gtfs_overlap() code. New functions get_route_frequency() get_stop_frequency(), return number departures mean headway route stop within time day (#53). New function stop_times_to_frequencies(), counterpart frequencies_to_stop_times(), approximates scheduled trips frequency-based ones (#69). New function interpolate_stop_times(), fills blank arrival_times departure_times stop_times, assuming constant speed stops known times. New function set_route_frequency(), editing counterpart get_route_frequency(), sets headway routes within time day replacing trips frequency-based template trip. Departures outside time day don’t change. New functions get_dwell_time() set_dwell_time(), return set long vehicles stay stops, optionally within time day. set_dwell_time() shifts later times trip accordingly. New function get_shape_length(), returns length shape. New function remove_unused_ids(), removes unused ids files (#55). New function list_validator_versions(), lists available validator versions. PR contribution @baarthur. get_trip_length() get_trip_speed() gain argument, calculate lengths speeds consecutive stops. get_trip_geometry() gain method argument, measure along trip’s shape straight lines stops. Without shapes, now fall back straight lines warning, instead raising error. set_trip_speed() gains first_stop, last_stop, arguments, change speeds two stops trips departing within time day (#89). frequencies_to_stop_times() gains strategy argument, shift departures frequency-based trips half headway random offset (#56). write_gtfs() gains compression_level argument. default, 6 (previously always 9), makes writing 2 3 times faster files similar size.
